scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
Applicant must be a resident of Goa.
Applicant or any household member must not be a defaulter with the Directorate of Fisheries.
Applicant must possess a registered fishing canoe.
Gill net must not be sold, leased, or transferred for five years after purchase.
The fishing net must be registered with the Directorate of Fisheries.
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy on fisheries requisites, capped at ₹30,000 for general category and ₹40,000 for SC/ST beneficiaries.
